svg.text: From upload to approved, searchable results. After step 8 the user can leave: steps 9–26 run in the background.
2. validate: magic bytes, size, page count
3. SHA-256 of the original, encrypt with a new DEK
6. document: status Received, SHA-256 (known hash: replaces)
12. decrypt in memory, PDF → PNG at 300 DPI
13. OCR, zone masking: keep table and date fields
14. leak check: second OCR pass on the masked image
15. status Blocked: continue in use case 3 (fail-closed)
17. delete working copy (24 h lifecycle as a backstop)
27. GET review: results + masked page images
29. every value next to its source on the page
31. flags: as printed by the lab, computed by code only if missing
35. embeddings for chunks of masked text
